SUPERIOR COURT OF THE STATE OF WESTBROOK, COUNTY OF MARION
FAMILY LAW DIVISION

In re the Marriage of WHITAKER     Case No. FL-2024-00871

RESPONDENT'S ANSWER AND COUNTER-PETITION

Respondent DEREK J. WHITAKER answers and counter-petitions as follows:

1. Admits the marriage date, separation date, and identities of the children.

2. Denies allegations regarding current substance abuse. Respondent acknowledges the 2022 DUI but states he completed inpatient treatment in February 2023 and has maintained sobriety since (excepting one documented relapse on 02/16/2024, the date referenced in Petitioner's pleading, for which Respondent immediately re-entered an outpatient program — see Ex. R-1, treatment compliance records).

3. Admits the 02/16/2024 school incident but disputes that Respondent "attempted to remove" L.W.; states he was attempting to "pick L.W. up because Petitioner had texted that she was running late."

4. Denies any pattern of domestic violence. States the 02/28/2024 incident was an isolated event during a verbal argument; protective order was issued ex parte and Respondent has complied with all conditions.

5. COUNTER-REQUEST: Respondent requests joint legal custody and equal (50/50) residential time, alternating weeks. Respondent has been actively involved in the children's lives, coaching L.W.'s soccer team for three seasons, attending all parent-teacher conferences (school records, Ex. R-2), and serving as primary caregiver during Petitioner's nursing-shift overnights.

6. Respondent requests evaluation by a court-appointed Custody Evaluator under W.S.A. § 41-6-309 to provide the Court with a neutral assessment.

7. Property: Respondent agrees to equitable division. Disputes Petitioner's request for exclusive use of the marital residence; requests parties continue to share residence until trial, alternating weeks consistent with the proposed parenting schedule.

8. Spousal maintenance: Opposed. The parties were both employed throughout the marriage; income disparity is not the result of any sacrifice for the marriage.

Dated: May 8, 2024
                                /s/ R. Donnelly, Esq.
